title: Flogo Data Pipeline
description: Schema for .datapipeline files — defines the source, transform, and sink stages of a Flogo ETL/ELT/EL pipeline.

name.description: Unique pipeline name (used as the binary and process name).

description.description: Human-readable description of what this pipeline does.

mode.description: Pipeline processing mode: ETL (transform before load), ELT (load then transform in the sink), or EL (extract and load with no transform layer).

source.description: Where the pipeline reads data from.

path.description: File system path or glob pattern (csv, parquet, fixedwidth, xml, jsonlines).

dsn.description: JDBC data source name / connection string (jdbc).

query.description: SQL SELECT query to execute against the JDBC source.

table.description: Table name — used when query is not set; generates SELECT * FROM <table>.

delimiter.description: Field delimiter character for CSV sources (default: ",").

hasHeader.description: Whether the CSV/fixed-width file has a header row (default: true).

schema.description: Explicit column/field schema (overrides auto-detection). Keys are field names, values are type strings (string, int, float, bool, timestamp).

startOffset.description: Kafka start offset: "earliest", "latest", or a numeric offset string.

prefix.description: Object store key prefix / folder path (objstore source).

region.description: Cloud region for the object store (objstore source).

endpoint.description: Custom endpoint URL for S3-compatible stores (objstore source).

pollIntervalSeconds.description: For streaming/polling sources: how often (in seconds) to check for new data.

xmlRootElement.description: XPath or element name that identifies each record root in the XML source.

transforms.description: Ordered list of transform stages applied to each record batch.

id.description: Optional stable identifier for this stage (used in metrics and logs).

description.description: Human-readable description of what this transform does.

expression.description: Filter/map expression in Flogo expression syntax (filter, map types).

fields.description: Field mapping: output field name -> Flogo expression or source field name (mapper type).

rules.description: Validation or data-quality rules (validate, dq types).

lookupSource.description: DSN or path for the lookup data set (lookup type).

lookupKey.description: Field name in the stream used as the lookup join key.

lookupFields.description: Fields to copy from the lookup row into the stream record.

hwmField.description: Field whose value is tracked as the high-water mark (hwm type).

driftAction.description: What to do when a schema drift is detected (schemadrift type).

sink.description: Where the pipeline writes processed records to.

dsn.description: JDBC data source name / connection string (jdbc sink).

writeMode.description: How to write rows to the target table (jdbc sink).

upsertKeys.description: Field names that form the unique key for upsert/merge (jdbc sink).

path.description: Output file or directory path (parquet, objstore sinks).

partitionBy.description: Field names to partition the output by (parquet sink).

prefix.description: Object store key prefix / folder path (objstore sink).

region.description: Cloud region for the object store (objstore sink).

endpoint.description: Custom endpoint URL for S3-compatible stores (objstore sink).

topic.description: Kafka topic to produce to (kafka sink).

keyField.description: Record field to use as the Kafka message key (kafka sink).

format.description: Message serialisation format for Kafka sink.

dlqSink.description: Optional dead-letter queue sink — receives records that fail validation or transforms when onFail is "dlq".

path.description: File path for file/parquet DLQ sink.

dsn.description: JDBC DSN for jdbc DLQ sink.

table.description: Table name for jdbc DLQ sink.

brokers.description: Kafka brokers for kafka DLQ sink.

batchSize.description: Number of records per processing batch.

maxMemoryMB.description: Soft cap on heap memory used by the pipeline (MiB). 0 = unlimited.

transformWorkers.description: Number of parallel goroutines in the transform layer.

sourceBufferBatches.description: Depth of the channel between source and transform stages (in batches).

sinkBufferBatches.description: Depth of the channel between transform and sink stages (in batches).

mode.description: Scaling strategy: single-instance, range-sharded, or fully distributed (requires a coordinator).

instanceIndex.description: Zero-based index of this instance (sharded mode).

instanceCount.description: Total number of parallel instances (sharded mode).

dsn.description: Connection string for the postgres coordinator backend.

leaseSeconds.description: TTL (in seconds) for distributed worker leases.

checkpoint.description: Progress checkpointing — allows the pipeline to resume after a restart without reprocessing already-committed records.

path.description: File path for the checkpoint state file (file backend).

keyPrefix.description: Redis key prefix used to namespace checkpoint entries (redis backend).

intervalRows.description: Flush the checkpoint every N committed rows. 0 = only on clean shutdown.

intervalSeconds.description: Flush the checkpoint every N seconds. 0 = only on clean shutdown.

deleteOnSuccess.description: Remove the checkpoint file/key when the pipeline exits cleanly.
